events.title: Woodstock Festival Anniversary
events.blurb: The iconic Woodstock Music & Art Fair, a pivotal moment in music history, took place in 1969.

angles.name: Woodstock Vibe
angles.copy: Fifty-seven years ago, a field in upstate New York became the epicentre of a counter-culture revolution. The music, the mud, the memories – Woodstock '69. What's your favourite track from the festival?

events.title: Elvis Presley Death Anniversary
events.blurb: The music world remembers the passing of the King of Rock and Roll, Elvis Presley, in 1977.

angles.name: Remembering The King
angles.copy: Remembering the King today. It's 49 years since we lost Elvis Presley, but his music lives on. What's your go-to Elvis track?

events.title: Jimi Hendrix Death Anniversary
events.blurb: On this day, we remember the legendary guitarist Jimi Hendrix, who passed away in 1970.

angles.name: Remembering Hendrix
angles.copy: Fifty-six years since we lost a true guitar icon. Jimi Hendrix's influence is still heard today. What's your favourite Hendrix riff?

events.title: The Beatles' Abbey Road Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their iconic eleventh studio album, 'Abbey Road', in 1969.

angles.name: Abbey Road Anniversary
angles.copy: The Fab Four's iconic 'Abbey Road' album turns 57 today. That zebra crossing, those timeless tracks. Which one is on your playlist?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: The lead singer of The Pretenders, Chrissie Hynde, celebrates her 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Chrissie Hynde's Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 75th Birthday to the legendary Chrissie Hynde! Still rocking with The Pretenders. What's your favourite track from her incredible career?

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Iconic Oasis frontman Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday today.

angles.name: Liam G Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 54th Birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher. Still bringing the rock and roll swagger. What's your favourite Oasis anthem?

events.title: Original iPod Anniversary
events.blurb: Apple unveiled the very first iPod in 2001, revolutionising how we listen to music.

angles.name: iPod Anniversary
angles.copy: Remember the day music went truly portable? Twenty-five years ago, Apple introduced the original iPod. How many songs did you cram onto yours?

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: James Bond Day celebrates the release of the first 007 film, 'Dr. No', in 1962.

angles.name: James Bond Day
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! Celebrating 64 years since 'Dr. No' hit screens. Who's your favourite Bond, and what's the best theme song?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: We remember the legendary John Lennon, who would have celebrated his 86th birthday today.

angles.name: Remembering John Lennon
angles.copy: Remembering John Lennon on what would have been his 86th birthday. His music and message continue to inspire. What's your favourite Lennon track?

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: The iconic comedian, actor, and writer John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: John Cleese Birthday
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the comedy legend, John Cleese. From Python to Fawlty Towers, a true British icon.

events.title: The Beatles' White Album Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles' groundbreaking double album, officially titled 'The Beatles' but known as the 'White Album', was released in 1968.

angles.name: White Album Anniversary
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years ago, The Beatles gave us the 'White Album'. A sprawling, diverse masterpiece. What's your standout track from it?

events.title: Freddie Mercury Death Anniversary
events.blurb: We remember the incomparable Freddie Mercury, who passed away in 1991, leaving behind an indelible musical legacy.

angles.name: Remembering Freddie
angles.copy: Thirty-five years since the world lost Freddie Mercury, but his voice and showmanship remain legendary. What's your favourite Queen track with Freddie?
